name: maintenance-hexapod
description: MH-6 Mk2 industrial hexapod: 18 servo joints on long legs, safety-yellow armour, one nose flashlight (spot), folding weapon hardpoint (twin cannon / rocket pod / shotgun attachments), blinking green mast tip. Rig: maintenance-hexapod.rig.json.

name: alien-bloater
description: Kamikaze bloater, ~1 m: six stubby legs carrying a huge pulsing sac with glowing red veins. Shuffles at you and detonates. Rig: alien-bloater.rig.json.

name: alien-nest-spire
description: Tall skitter nest spire: a stack of breathing egg sacs; strands reach walls, corners and the ceiling. Rig: alien-nest-spire.rig.json.

name: alien-nest
description: Gooey skitter nest: breathing glass egg sacs with curled embryos on a wet mound. Strands stick to nearby walls, corners, ceilings and neighbouring nests. Rig: alien-nest.rig.json.

name: alien-skitter
description: Tiny skittering parasite, 0.6 m leg span: eight needle legs, swollen abdomen with glowing violet veins, red eye cluster, twitching fangs. Rig: alien-skitter.rig.json (hectic, erratic).

name: alien-crawler
description: Hostile crystal crawler, 2.6 m leg span: ten spider-high legs, crystal spine, scorpion tail with venom sac, hook mandibles, eight mint eyes. Rig: alien-crawler.rig.json (hectic, erratic).

name: alien-leecher
description: Compact four-hook parasite with twin siphons and charged dorsal crystals.

name: diesel-tank
description: 5.5m horizontal diesel reservoir, banded shell, saddles, fill hatch, ladder and drain.

name: pipe-straight
description: 4m straight open-bore rusty pipe with bolt flanges and supports.

name: pipe-elbow
description: 90-degree open-bore pipe corner; mates to the straight run.

name: pipe-tee
description: Three-way pipe junction with continuous hollow bore.

name: wall-panel
description: 4m x 3.2m ribbed steel wall, kickplate, vents and painted ID patch.

name: bulkhead-door
description: Closed split blast door, warning stripes, glass viewing windows and red access reader; 4m module.

name: wall-window
description: 4m x 3.2m wall module with a glazed viewing band and mullions.

name: doorway
description: Open doorway module: 4m wall with a 2.4m passage, framed and hazard-marked.

name: corner-post
description: Corner post for room corners: 0.8m square steel column with a yellow band.

name: work-lamp
description: 2.8m standing work floodlight: warm bulb behind a glass lens, wire cage, tripod.

name: beacon
description: Emergency beacon: red emitter under a glass dome on a short bracket.

name: corridor-floor
description: 4m square deck tile, raised tread plates and yellow edge markings.

name: control-console
description: Freestanding terminal with blue display, keyboard, status lights and emergency stop.

name: diesel-generator
description: 3m skid generator, cooling grille, yellow end guards, exhaust and service lights.

name: service-crate
description: Reinforced maintenance supply crate, yellow lid, recessed handle and latches.

name: mega-reactor-tower
description: 29.75m reactor tower: hollow pressure vessel, service balcony, external cooling risers, ladder and tiny access door.

name: mega-turbine
description: 30m turbine assembly with ribbed barrel, inspection doors, rooftop service walk and exhaust stack.

name: mega-blast-gate
description: 30m wide, 25.25m tall OPEN industrial gate; 20m clear aperture, hydraulic rams, upper walkway and human-scale service door.

name: mega-cooling-tower
description: 30m hyperboloid cooling tower with open throat, intake piers, external ribs, ladder and rim railing.

name: mega-pipe-bridge
description: 30m pipe bridge, 12m clear ground clearance, twin 2.5m process pipes, cross-braced trusses and service ladder.

name: mega-storage-silo
description: 31.25m storage silo with domed roof, circumferential stiffeners, service balcony, ladder, fill riser and painted tank ID.

name: mega-foundation
description: 24m square heavy foundation deck; broad steel plates, expansion joints, anchor bolts and hazard-marked edges. Top surface is 1m high.

name: rock-boulder-low
description: Low broad 5m basalt boulder; bevelled planes and subtle strata.

name: rock-boulder-split
description: Split basalt boulder with a deep inclined cleft; two uneven halves.

name: rock-boulder-upright
description: Upright wind-worn pale boulder; angled cap, buttress and broad sediment bands.

name: rock-layered-outcrop
description: ~20m layered escarpment, staggered slabs and slanted exposed strata.

name: rock-spire-cluster
description: ~23m tall eroded basalt needles; three unequal spires and a shared rocky foot.

name: rock-natural-arch
description: ~22m natural stone arch with an open passage, asymmetric piers and a massive sloped lintel.

name: rock-scree-patch
description: Loose field of fifteen angular stones, varying size and orientation; no artificial slab underneath.

name: dead-tree-crooked
description: ~7m crooked leafless tree; exposed roots, leaning trunk and snapped asymmetric limbs.

name: dead-tree-forked
description: Tall forked dead tree; heavier charred base and two bleached, broken crowns.

name: dead-tree-fallen
description: Fallen trunk with pale broken end grain and three snapped branches; ~6m long.

name: dead-stump-hollow
description: Hollow broken stump with a dark heart, exposed pale rim, splinters and roots.

name: dead-scrub-spreading
description: Low spreading wind-flattened dead scrub, radial twisted twigs; no leaves.

name: dead-scrub-upright
description: Narrow upright dead thorn scrub, irregular twigs; no leaves.

name: dead-agave
description: Desiccated alien rosette: nine broad drooping blades and a brittle central spear; bone-grey, no green.

name: corridor-clean-floor
description: 4m square quiet deck: four broad plates, recessed cross seam, sparse amber edge markers. Walking surface Y=0.3m.

name: corridor-clean-wall
description: 4m x 3.2m double-sided wall; large flat panels, restrained base trim, one seam, no voxel speckle.

name: corridor-clean-window
description: 4m clean wall with a broad transparent observation pane and one mullion; matches the existing glass material.

name: corridor-clean-doorway
description: Open 2.8m-wide, 2.7m-high passage frame; broad surfaces, warm header light, access panel.

name: corridor-clean-straight
description: Open-top 4m straight module: smooth floor, two 3.2m walls, one observation window. Overall height 3.5m.

name: corridor-clean-corner
description: Open-top 4m corner module, openings on +X and -Y in the Z-up source; broad unbroken panels.

name: corridor-clean-junction
description: Open-top 4m T-junction: one glazed back wall, three matching full-width connections.

name: corridor-clean-ceiling
description: 4m removable ceiling tile; two recessed warm linear lights on underside, broad clean panels. Place at Y=3.5m over complete modules.

name: alien-flutter
description: Cave-wing: 0.85 m wingspan, six hooked legs, four veined wings, feelers and pale glow-only eyes. Perches, chirps, flits and defends itself.

name: ash-scavenger
description: Ash scavenger: small sand-coloured plated beetle, six hooked legs and probing feelers. Forages in groups; flees first, fights when disturbed. Layer 0.

name: dune-stalker
description: Dune stalker: tall four-legged salt-bone hunter, rust armour, dorsal sail-spines and hooked jaws. Watches from ridges, braces, then charges. A larger elder guards the surface rift. Layer 0.

name: rift-monument
description: Broken basalt rift monument. Dormant stone arch; gameplay adds counter-rotating luminous rings, a vortex, rising motes and one light after the layer boss falls.

name: br4-mortar
description: BR-4 "Mortar": wide armoured artillery quadruped, huge splayed legs with elephant pads, turret-mounted quad rocket launcher, one flood lamp. Slow and heavy. Rig: br4-mortar.rig.json.

name: cq1-maul
description: CQ-1 "Maul": low wedge on eight short claw legs behind a raked riot shield with ram teeth and red eye slits; a double-barrel shotgun pokes through the shield port. Fastest mech. Rig: cq1-maul.rig.json.
